name: Yousei Kareshi
source:
The main character is a woman who works hard. She moved to a condominium near her office, but she's so busy she doesn't have time to put away her luggage. The night she gets tired, a fairy (brownie) possesses her house appears. He looks like a tall handsome guy. She says she helps with housework because she is the main character who became the landlord...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230104045506/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.yoseikare]Google Play[/url]]
